About Pool

A casual eight-ball table rebuilt for the browser. The cloth, balls and pockets are rendered separately, with their own impact and drop sounds, while the power meter and cue-ball contact point keep every shot under your control.

Play the computer when you are alone, or create a room and send the invite link — both players land on the same table instantly.

How to play

  1. The first legal pot assigns solids (1–7) or stripes (9–15); potting your own group keeps the turn.
  2. After the assignment, hitting the opponent group first, missing your own group or scratching gives the opponent an extra shot.
  3. Clear your group, then legally pot the 8-ball to win. An early 8-ball or a scratch on the 8 loses. After 200 shots the higher pocket count wins.

Frequently asked questions

Is this full competition eight-ball rules?
No. This is a simplified, faster casual variant tuned for short online matches rather than tournament rules.
Do I need to download or register?
No. Open the page and play as a guest. An account is only needed if you want your Joy Coins and stats saved.
Can I invite a friend?
Yes. Create a room, share the invite link and you both land on the same table, taking alternating shots.
